items.source_en:
All four subjects have remained stable for 10 months. Monitoring shows minimal fluctuations in energy patterns. Awareness and intelligence are unaffected, regardless of the number of experiments performed. There is no degradation in their ability.

Additional efforts to increase transference range have been unsuccessful. The Vortex interlocks were key to enabling site-to-site transference in the first place, but appear to remain essential.

Even if increasing the range is out of our grasp for now, developing the Vortex Interlock has been crucial in advancing the technology.

Note: subjects have been reporting "dreams" that suggest some sort of extra-spatial ability. Frequent mentions of events occurring outside the facility they could otherwise have no knowledge of. Catalog all instances and cross-check for accuracy.
items.legacy_ko:
피험자 넷 모두 10개월 동안 안정화된 상태를 보였다. 모니터링 결과 에너지 패턴에서 최소 수준의 변동만이 감지되었다. 의식이나 지능도 실험 수와 상관없이 아무 영향도 받지 않았다. 능력 수준에 아무런 퇴화가 없다.

전이 범위를 늘리기 위한 추가 조치는 아무런 실익도 거두지 못했다. 볼텍스 제어장치 덕분에 각 장소 간의 전이를 실현할 수 있었지만 초기 수준을 벗어나지 못하는 것으로 보인다.

지금 당장 범위를 늘리는 것은 불가능하더라도, 볼텍스 제어장치를 개발한 덕분에 이 기술을 비약적으로 향상시킬 수 있었다.

items.source_en:
Agent No. 1 is dead. Murdered by one of our own, Volk. His insubordination and cruel ways were called out by Agent No. 1. He was reprimanded, and took issue with it. Violently exacting his grievances when No. 1 was most vulnerable.

He didn't go down without a fight, but we managed to subdue and capture him before he could escape, with only minimal collateral damage to the Cave. After following the late Agent No. 1's will and naming a successor, myself, as the new Agent No. 1, I called for Volk's execution by firing squad. Needless to say, every Tracker volunteered, but we had to limit it to twenty.

From here on out, Volk's service will be stricken from the records. All accomplishments and acknowledgement will be wiped from databases, books, and other communications. If any of Volk's relatives or associates come asking about him, they will be told he died on a secretive bounty mission which we are not at liberty to discuss. 

Otherwise, I want to make it clear that I do not wish to hear his name uttered in my presence, or within the walls of this or any future headquarters.
items.legacy_ko:
대행인 1호는 죽었다. 우리 중 하나인 볼크에 의해 살해당했다. 볼크의 불복종과 잔인한 행동을 1호가 지적한 것이다. 볼크는 질책을 받았고, 이에 반발했다. 1호가 가장 취약할 때, 볼크는 폭력적으로 그 불만을 표출했다.

볼크는 강하게 저항했지만, 우리는 볼크가 도망치기 전에 제압하고 붙잡았으며, 이 과정에서 일어난 최소한의 피해는 불가피했다. 1호의 유언에 따라 후계자로서 내가 새로운 대행인 1호로 지명되었고, 나는 볼크의 총살을 명했다. 모든 추적자가 총살형 집행에 자원했기에, 20명으로 제한해야 했다.

To All Personnel:

It is crucial that the correct wattage is set before performing any experiment. Until the next phase of our larger project is complete, we are reliant on energy that can be acquired directly from the dam. This energy has been shown to vary depending on external factors. 

Exercise particular caution when the hydroelectrics are in LOW POWER or RESTRICTED mode. 
During these periods the value must be increased by 100 to compensate. Failure to comply could result in damage to equipment and/or bodily harm.

Herald Inaza has brought to my attention a disturbing matter: There has been discussion of eliminating the funding to maintain and preserve the Serpent's Path in the latest proposed budget. I find this surprising, given the paltry amount requested and the significance of the location.

I am confident that the Council will make the right decision. And if the funding cannot be secured, I would be more than happy to personally take a closer look at the budget to see what areas might be trimmed in order to free up funds.
